facts.fact: ARCEP Gabon says Gabon Telecom and Airtel Money provide mobile money through the banks UGB and BGFIBank, which hold COBAC approvals to issue electronic money.
ARCEP Gabon says COBAC ensures interoperability of mobile payment systems in the CEMAC zone through its GIMACPAY platform.

GAB.note: Document states no consumer protection rules or redress body.

facts.fact: ARCEP Gabon reports mobile money transfers within the CEMAC zone of 1.489 billion FCFA in 2022, up 66.6% on 2021.
ARCEP Gabon says mobile payment interoperability in the CEMAC zone runs through the GIMACPAY platform.
ARCEP Gabon, citing the Ministry of Economy, gives CEMAC-zone mobile money transfers as 0.894 billion FCFA in 2021 and 1.489 billion FCFA in 2022.

GAB.note: Document does not mention government payments to people.
Only a SIM-based penetration rate is given, not a share of people owning a phone.
Only account counts are given, no survey share of adults.

facts.fact: ARCEP Gabon says mobile money has operated in Gabon since 2012, led by Airtel Gabon with an 82% client share in 2023, alongside Moov Africa Gabon Telecom.

GAB.note: National interoperability stated as still being addressed, so no interop fact.
Document does not mention electronic payment of taxes or fees.
